transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Thanks for calling Riverbend Auto Service, this is Charlie. How can I help today?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Hi Charlie, this is Sam. I need to move my booking for my Mazda BT-50 to another morning later in the week or early next week.

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Hi Sam, is this about the Mazda BT-50? You already have a booking for Monday, the second of November at eight. What day or time were you thinking of moving it to?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. I was hoping to move it to either later in the week or early next week.

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: I have a few slots available for you on Tuesday, the third of November: at eight, at eight thirty, or at nine. Which one suits you best?

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Could I move it to eight thirty on Tuesday, the third of November?

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text:
You're all set! Your minor service for the Mazda BT-50 is now on Tuesday, the third of November at eight thirty. 

Thanks for calling Riverbend Auto Service, see you then!

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Thank you, Charlie! See you then.

transcript.speaker: Charlie
transcript.text: Thanks for calling Riverbend Auto Service, see you then!
